sources.snippet: Meta Llama 3.1 is a family of multilingual large language models developed by Meta, featuring pretrained and instruction-tuned variants in 8B, 70B, and 405B parameter sizes. This 8B instruction-tuned model is optimized for multilingual dialogue use cases and outperforms many available open-source and closed chat models on common industry benchmarks.
